title: RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0.1 Is HERE! HUGE Changes You NEED to Know!
author: GamerCory
description:
RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0.1 is HERE, and this update brings some HUGE changes that players NEED to know about!

Jagex has officially released update 1.0.1, bringing exciting new gameplay mechanics, combat improvements, inventory upgrades, quality-of-life changes, and important bug fixes throughout Ashenfall.

But there's more to this update than you might expect!

Some of these changes could make your adventures considerably easier, while others introduce new ways to approach combat, crafting, exploration, and progression.

In this video, we're breaking down the biggest changes in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0.1, including some easily overlooked improvements that could make a real difference in how you play.

Whether you're just starting out or already exploring the toughest areas of Ashenfall, there's plenty worth knowing about this latest update!

What do YOU think about Dragonwilds 1.0.1? Which changes are you most excited about, and what would you still like Jagex to improve? Let me know in the comments!

Official Patch Notes:
https://dragonwilds.runescape.com/news/eye-on-ashenfall-1-0-1
